source_findings.finding: Existing fixed seven marker pairs and original ordered ownership oracle already require simultaneous-visible-windows, but the declaration is not a runtime admission check.
The driver proceeds from B readiness directly toward the manual boundary. Runtime overlap must be qualified before that boundary; a post-run screenshot or22/22 semantic pass is insufficient.

Existing exact logical/native/generation/window access can collect live main-thread observations without changing SDK behavior. Cached snapshots, readiness alone and local window frames do not prove simultaneously visible content.
Existing pre-SDK installed-Mach-O receipt and optional native JSONL capture support physical collection without a debugger.
App deployment27.0 is compatible with the discovered physical27.0 device; existing Duo UI-test target deployment27.1 is not. Do not silently relabel or run that UI target on27.0.

next_definition_requirements: After device availability is confirmed, define one physical H01 slice before any new collector implementation or native run; freeze signed source/fixture/oracle identities.

Add a bounded precritical admission seam to this scenario only. No manual start may run before a fresh run-bound operator/host topology receipt and a fresh live native check agree on two distinct current scene identities/generations.

Require visible A and B content in independent active-display evidence captured before admission; retain a continuous capture through the critical interval. Activation and local frames alone never establish visibility or occlusion.

Record live native topology immediately before each manual start/stop and corresponding ownership marker, then retain lifecycle/geometry observations through the final marker. Reject hidden/background/detached/replaced scenes or changed identities during the critical interval.

Preserve the original seven named Action/Resource pairs, exact ordered semantics, two distinct Compose owners, B stop preserving A Compose and fresh Home returns. Do not treat logical peers as physical windows.

Use fresh clean installation and run UUID, verify every installed Mach-O against the exact signed app via its pre-SDK receipt and independently observed process ID. Refresh authentication only when backend collection becomes executable.
Require complete session-only backend view/work/error/crash inventories with exact mapper event IDs/owners; preserve raw exchanges and pagination/count provenance.

If topology or an input cannot be qualified, stop before mutation and retain INCONCLUSIVE. Allow at most two equivalent environment failures; any collector repair requires a new frozen source and fresh run.
Verify scoped probe/runner cleanup and unchanged protected paths. H01 physical iPad acceptance would not replace F04 Duo hardware acceptance or other H02–H16/F05 obligations.
